# Authenticated routes that rely on the start-of-request session check alone.
# Every other authenticated route takes FenceDep and re-validates before release.
# A new authenticated route must do one or the other; add it here only when a
# reviewer agrees nothing private is released after slow work. One "METHOD /path"
# per line; test_session_fence_architecture.py keeps this list exact.
# GET /api/reports/{report_id} and its /markdown export are listed because their
# final session read happens uncached inside application/reports/document_release.py.
